summary: First-run end-to-end testing of Fashion Interior backend (FastAPI) and frontend (React). 19/20 backend pytest tests pass. All public + admin flows work in the UI (login, sidebar nav, all CRUD pages render, logout, auth-guard redirect). One CRITICAL backend bug found: /api/admin/reset-password always returns 400 'Token has expired' due to broken operator precedence in the expiry-check expression — the password-reset flow is functionally broken even though /api/admin/forgot-password works.
action_items: URGENT: Fix the password-reset expiry comparison in /app/backend/server.py around line 320-327 (admin_reset). The current ternary expression is broken; rewrite as two explicit statements (normalise tz, then compare). After the fix, the reset_password_flow test in backend_test.py will pass (it triggers forgot-password, reads the token from MongoDB password_reset_tokens, and POSTs reset-password).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_reset expiry-check: dangerous one-liner combining `and`+ternary+`<`; rewrite for clarity (see action_items).

Resend's `resend.Emails.send` is wrapped in asyncio.to_thread — good. But the function silently returns False on Resend errors and only logs; consider returning a non-200 status only in non-production so QA notices misconfig.
No rate-limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/admin/login. The playbook mentions a `login_attempts` collection and 5-fail lockout, but there is no implementation. Consider adding before launch.

CORS is allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True. Browsers ignore credentials with wildcard origin; this works only because frontend uses Bearer token in localStorage. Cookie-based auth fallback (samesite=none, secure=true) would not actually be sent cross-origin — this is fine but worth documenting.
Single-file server.py at 642 lines is borderline; consider splitting auth, admin, public, seeds into separate modules before adding more features.
admin_reset and admin_forgot do not invalidate previously issued reset tokens for the same user — multiple unused tokens accumulate. Consider marking older tokens used when issuing a new one.

/api/admin/login response leaks role/email even on success (acceptable) but error message 'Invalid email or password' vs 'Not an admin account' (403) lets an attacker enumerate non-admin emails. Use a single 401 for both paths.
Frontend admin login currently uses Bearer-only — backend cookie path is dead code; either remove or enable cookie auth path with matching withCredentials on axios.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke tests (login, all admin sub-pages, logout, auth-guard, public homepage, hero headline visible, contact form, WhatsApp button)

seed_data_creation: None (relied on auto-seed: 5 portfolio + 25 testimonials + business_info + admin user). Created and cleaned up TEST_ inquiries inside tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and use real Mongo via MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017, DB=fashion_interior. The single failing test (TestPasswordReset::test_reset_password_flow) is a real backend bug, not a flaky test — re-run the same file after the fix in admin_reset (server.py ~line 326). Frontend uses localStorage key 'fi_admin_token' for Bearer auth; backend also sets an httpOnly cookie that is not used. Public homepage has a 1.5–2s loader, so always sleep ~3s after navigating to /. Hero headline is split into animated spans, so substring matching for 'Spaces That Tell Your Story' fails — verify visually or check parts separately.
rca_of_the_issue: RCA — reset-password 400 always: (1) PyMongo by default returns BSON datetimes as naive `datetime` (tzinfo None). (2) The expression `expires_at and expires_at.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) if expires_at.tzinfo is None else expires_at < datetime.now(timezone.utc)` is parsed by Python as `(A and B) if C else D` because the ternary `if/else` has lower precedence than `<`. (3) When tzinfo is None (the common case), the ternary returns a datetime (truthy), so `if <datetime>:` is True and the 400 is raised regardless of actual expiry. Reproduction: POST /api/admin/forgot-password → fetch newest token from db.password_reset_tokens → POST /api/admin/reset-password with {token, new_password} → returns 400 'Token has expired' even seconds after creation. Fix: split into explicit normalisation + comparison statements (see action_items).
